tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Exact brand Deep Navy. Marks, wordmark and printed material. In UI use `heading`, `primary` or `surface`, which carry the theme.

tokens.name: brand-orange
tokens.usage: Exact brand Burnt Orange. Marks, bearing lines and display text 24px+ only (4.24:1 on white). Never body text, links or button labels: use `accent`. On navy it is 2.86:1, so there it is decoration only.

tokens.name: brand-charcoal
tokens.usage: Exact brand Charcoal Gray. Identity blocks and print. In UI use `text`. Never next to `brand-navy` as the only edge between two areas (1.11:1).

tokens.name: brand-slate
tokens.usage: Exact brand Slate White. Marks on dark grounds and identity blocks.

tokens.name: navy-block
tokens.usage: Large navy identity fields (covers, hero bands). Lifted in dark so the field still reads against `ground`.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind surfaces.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, forms, tables and dialogs placed on `ground`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on `ground` and `surface` (10.09:1 and 10.93:1 light; 14.9:1 and 12.12:1 dark).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Headings and table headers on `ground` and `surface` (11.19:1 or better).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints, timestamps on `ground` and `surface` (5.03:1 or better light; 8.0:1 or better dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected states. The default action color in data-heavy views such as Bearing Register's register and heat map.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for `primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary` and `primary-hover` (10.66:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, accent text and the one call-to-action button on a screen, on `ground` and `surface` (4.72:1 and 5.11:1 light; 6.24:1 and 4.69:1 dark). Kept out of Bearing Register data views so it can't be read as a risk tier.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for `accent` links and buttons (6.95:1 on white; 5.74:1 on dark `surface`).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` or `accent-hover` fill (5.11:1 or better light; 6.24:1 or better dark).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs, checkboxes, selects and secondary buttons: the edge that shows a control exists (3.46:1 or better light; 4.53:1 or better dark).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and table rules. Never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px offset, on every surface (11.19:1 or better light; 5.74:1 or better dark). Distinct from `accent` so it shows on orange buttons.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, error icons and the invalid-field outline on `ground`, `surface` and `error-bg`. Always with an icon and words: its hue sits near `accent`.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Background of an error alert. `text` and `error` both read on it (9.56:1 and 5.75:1 light; 13.74:1 and 6.52:1 dark).

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Warning status text, icon and outline, such as QuestVector's "Gaps" match status. Always with a word and an icon. On `caution-bg` 6.79:1 light, 8.75:1 dark; on `surface` 7.48:1 and 7.44:1. Not a brand or data color. Added 29 Oct 2026.

tokens.name: caution-bg
tokens.usage: Background for caution chips and notices, paired with `caution`.

tokens.name: qv-accent
tokens.usage: QuestVector's own accent (Horizon blue): the active tab, the selected mission template, gauge and instrument highlights, on `ground` and `surface` (5.38:1 and 5.83:1 light; 7.68:1 and 5.76:1 dark). Not for links or the call to action (those stay `accent`), and never the only difference from `brand-navy` (2.08:1).

tokens.name: on-qv-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `qv-accent` fill (5.83:1 light; 7.68:1 dark).

tokens.name: tier-low
tokens.usage: Bearing Register Low tier chip fill. Always with the word Low and the dollar figure, plus a `control` outline because the fill alone is close to `ground`.

tokens.name: tier-medium
tokens.usage: Bearing Register Medium tier chip fill. Always with the word Medium and the dollar figure.

tokens.name: tier-high
tokens.usage: Bearing Register High tier chip fill. Always with the word High and the dollar figure.

tokens.name: tier-critical
tokens.usage: Bearing Register Critical tier chip fill. Always with the word Critical and the dollar figure. The scale runs blue to violet, ordered by lightness, and never uses orange or red.

tokens.name: on-tier-low
tokens.usage: Text on `tier-low` (9.36:1 light; 8.29:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-tier-medium
tokens.usage: Text on `tier-medium` (7.18:1 light; 5.11:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-tier-high
tokens.usage: Text on `tier-high` (5.94:1 light; 7.08:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-tier-critical
tokens.usage: Text on `tier-critical` (13.26:1 light; 11.41:1 dark).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Product and family names only. Cinzel is a capitals face: never headings, labels or running text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Phished credentials could give an attacker access to the support console.
styles.usage: Running text, in `text`. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and column labels, in `muted`.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Dollar figures and counts. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns align.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; button horizontal padding is space-4.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; minimum page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form groups and panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top and bottom page padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and cover insets.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tier chips, inputs, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and dialogs. The largest corner in the system: the look is precise, not soft.

shadow.note: Borders separate areas; shadow is reserved for things that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only.
